level.title: Mandarin C1+ — Advanced synthesis, editorial judgement and interpretation
goals: Synthesize sources while retaining method and scope differences.
Mediate accounts and edit institutional prose without inflating certainty.
Write balanced summaries that keep unresolved issues visible.

lessons.title: Find a shared result
lessons.learn: State one result shared by two sources and name the difference between them.

grammar.title: synthesis with 不过
grammar.explain: Synthesize a shared finding without erasing a difference in sample or method.

examples.r: liǎng xiàng yán jiū dōu fā xiàn cān yù rén shù yǒu suǒ zēng jiā。

lessons.title: Attribute an institutional statement
lessons.learn: Report an institution's statement without presenting it as independent verification.

grammar.title: attribution with 根据
grammar.pattern: 根据机构的说明 ...；独立核实 ...
grammar.explain: Attribute the claim and say whether an independent check has occurred.

lessons.title: Explain a methodological limit
lessons.learn: Explain how the sample constrains the reach of a conclusion.

grammar.title: method and scope
grammar.explain: Connect a method or sample limit to the population the finding can describe.

culture.text: A formal Chinese report can distinguish a source's statement, a directly observed result and the writer's interpretation. Phrases such as 据报告 and 由此可见 signal different relationships to evidence. Naming those relationships helps readers assess the conclusion without overstating what the source establishes. At C1+, the learner balances concision, scope and uncertainty. Simplifying a technical passage should not turn a provisional interpretation into a confirmed fact; a careful summary can also leave room for unresolved disagreement.

reading.text: 两项研究都发现参与人数增加，但研究地点和统计时间不同。把结果放在一起看，可以看到一个共同趋势；语境差异仍然会影响解释。 研究者把结果称为初步发现，并说明样本有限。编辑缩短了句子，但保留了这两个限制。读者可以据此判断结论适用的范围。
reading.gloss: Both studies found an increase in participation, but their locations and measurement periods differed. Read together, they show a shared trend; contextual differences still affect the interpretation. The researcher called the result preliminary and noted that the sample was limited. The editor shortened the sentence but kept both limitations. Readers can use them to judge the conclusion's scope.

listening.script:
编辑：两项研究是不是互相矛盾？
研究者：不一定，样本和时间都不同。
编辑：那总结要保留这个区别。
研究者：对，也要注明共同的趋势。
研究者：改写以后，结论还是暂定的吗？
编辑：是，证据范围没有改变。
研究者：很好，也请保留样本限制。
listening.gloss: Editor: Do the two studies contradict one another? Researcher: Not necessarily; their samples and periods differ. Editor: Then the summary should retain that distinction. Researcher: Yes, and note the shared trend as well. Researcher: Is the conclusion still provisional after the rewrite? Editor: Yes; the evidence scope has not changed. Researcher: Good; please keep the sample limitation too.
